# Test fixtures

| File | Provenance |
| --- | --- |
| `legacy-complete.txt` | Real `entire checkpoint explain --commit deae614` output, captured from this repo. |
| `legacy-missing.txt` | Real `entire checkpoint explain` output for a commit with no checkpoint trailer. |
| `legacy-list.txt` | Real `entire checkpoint list` output — the weak tier-2 source. |
| `jsonl-v2-complete.jsonl` | **The integrated agent's own published session fixture, verbatim** (`track-3-agent-session.jsonl`). Authoritative for the new format: `event` discriminator, `session_started`/`user_prompt`/`agent_response`/`tool_call`/`tool_result`/`file_read`/`file_changed`/`usage`/`checkpoint_created`/`session_ended`, no `schema_version` field. |
| `jsonl-v2-equivalent.jsonl` | The *same session content* as `legacy-complete.txt`, re-expressed in the new format. This is what makes "both formats normalize to the same shape" a real assertion rather than a shape-only one. |
| `jsonl-v2-unknown-events.jsonl` | Real vocabulary plus event types this build has never seen (`sandbox_provisioned`, `permission_mode`, `telemetry_flush`). |
| `jsonl-v2-truncated.jsonl` | Opened and never closed, with a cut-off final line. |
| `golden-legacy-complete.md` | **Generated by the PRE-CURVEBALL implementation**, at commit `15f2c55`, before any edit in this change. `golden-input.mjs.txt` is the exact generator used. This is the regression lock: byte equality proves existing behaviour is preserved. |

Regenerating the golden from the *current* code would make the regression test
a tautology. It is committed deliberately as a frozen artefact of the old
behaviour.
